title: Outbox
description: Health of the transactional outbox that feeds RabbitMQ: queue depth per schema, publish latency, and dead-lettering.

panels.title: Queue depth by schema
panels.query: sacco_outbox_queue_depth{schema=*} plotted over time, one series per schema label ("platform" plus each active tenant schema).

panels.title: Queue depth by schema (current)
panels.query: sacco_outbox_queue_depth{schema=*} — latest value per schema label, sorted descending, to spot a single tenant backing up.

panels.title: Publish latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.query: histogram_quantile(0.5 | 0.95 | 0.99, sacco_outbox_publish_duration_seconds) over the selected time range.
panels.notes: This histogram has no labels; it aggregates publish latency across all schemas/event types.

panels.title: Dead-lettered events (rate)
panels.query: rate(sacco_outbox_dead_lettered_total) bucketed per hour. Any sustained non-zero rate indicates events exceeding max publish attempts.
panels.notes: This counter has no labels; it is a single platform-wide series (dead-lettering happens on both platform and tenant outbox tables via the same worker code path).
